C115.name: Kigoma-Ujiji Municipal Council
C115.documented: earthquake on the Tanganyika Rift, large waves and boat accidents on the lake, heavy rain, and cholera

area.en: Kigoma-Ujiji Municipal: Lake Tanganyika shore and hillside streets
area.sw: Manispaa ya Kigoma-Ujiji: ufukwe wa Ziwa Tanganyika na mitaa ya milimani

risk.en: This area lies between steep hills and Lake Tanganyika: storm run-off cuts gullies through hillside streets, low lakeside areas flood, and the dense port and market areas are prone to cholera outbreaks.
risk.sw: Eneo hili liko kati ya milima mikali na Ziwa Tanganyika: maji ya dhoruba huchimba makorongo kwenye mitaa ya milimani, maeneo ya chini ya ufukweni hufurika, na bandari na masoko yenye msongamano hukumbwa na milipuko ya kipindupindu.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to keep drains and gullies clear, build back from the shoreline, and store and treat drinking water safely.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kuweka mitaro na makorongo wazi, kujenga mbali na ufukwe, na kuhifadhi na kutibu maji ya kunywa kwa usalama.

C113.name: Kasulu Town Council
C113.documented: heavy Msimu rain, valley floods, strong winds, and hillside erosion

area.en: Kasulu Town: hillside town and river valleys
area.sw: Mji wa Kasulu: mji wa milimani na mabonde ya mito

risk.en: This area is a hillside town where heavy rain sends flash floods through valley streets and gullies, and lightning is frequent during the rains.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji wa milimani ambapo mvua kubwa hupeleka mafuriko ya ghafla kwenye mitaa ya mabondeni na makorongo, na radi hupiga mara kwa mara wakati wa mvua.

advice.en: For those living and building here, it helps to keep slopes planted, build away from gully edges and fit lightning arresters on schools and public buildings.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kujenga hapa, ni vyema kuacha mimea kwenye miteremko, kujenga mbali na kingo za makorongo na kuweka vizuia radi shuleni na kwenye majengo ya umma.

C117.name: Buhigwe District Council
C117.documented: heavy rain, landslides on the highland edge, and valley floods

area.sw: Buhigwe: nyanda za juu za mpakani zenye miteremko mikali

risk.en: This area is steep, densely farmed highland on the Burundi border: saturated slopes slide in heavy rain, and hailstorms damage crops and roofs.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni nyanda za juu zenye miteremko mikali na kilimo kingi mpakani mwa Burundi: miteremko iliyolowa huporomoka wakati wa mvua kubwa, na mvua ya mawe huharibu mazao na paa.

advice.en: For those farming and living here, it helps to keep terraces, trees and grass strips on slopes and to build away from steep cuts and stream banks.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima na kuishi hapa, ni vyema kutunza matuta, miti na mistari ya nyasi kwenye miteremko na kujenga mbali na miinuko mikali na kingo za vijito.

C118.name: Kakonko District Council
C118.documented: heavy rain in the Vuli fringe, valley floods, and lightning

area.en: Kakonko: miombo farmland and border villages
area.sw: Kakonko: mashamba ya miombo na vijiji vya mpakani

risk.en: This area has miombo farmland and border villages where dry-season fires spread fast, dry spells damage crops, and cross-border movement can carry disease.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba ya miombo na vijiji vya mpakani ambapo moto wa kiangazi husambaa haraka, vipindi vya ukavu huharibu mazao, na mwingiliano wa mpakani unaweza kusambaza magonjwa.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to burn early and under control, plant drought-tolerant crops and report unusual illness early to the health facility.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuchoma mapema kwa udhibiti, kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame na kutoa taarifa mapema za magonjwa yasiyo ya kawaida kituo cha afya.

C112.name: Kasulu District Council
C112.documented: heavy rain, landslides, and floods on valleys draining west

area.en: Kasulu DC: hills, valleys and refugee-hosting areas
area.sw: Kasulu DC: milima, mabonde na maeneo yanayohifadhi wakimbizi

risk.en: This area has hills and valleys with dense settlements, including refugee-hosting areas, where floods, landslides and water-borne disease spread quickly in the rains.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina milima na mabonde yenye makazi mengi, yakiwemo maeneo yanayohifadhi wakimbizi, ambapo mafuriko, maporomoko ya ardhi na magonjwa yatokanayo na maji husambaa haraka wakati wa mvua.

advice.en: For those living here, it helps to build off valley floors and steep slopes, keep latrines away from water sources and boil or treat drinking water.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi hapa, ni vyema kujenga nje ya sakafu za mabonde na miteremko mikali, kujenga vyoo mbali na vyanzo vya maji na kuchemsha au kutibu maji ya kunywa.

C111.name: Kibondo District Council
C111.documented: heavy rain, valley floods, and a sharp dry season

area.sw: Kibondo: mashamba na vijito vya Malagarasi

risk.en: This area has farmland drained by Malagarasi tributaries that flood crossings and fields in heavy rain, and dry-season fires in the surrounding woodland.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba yanayopitiwa na vijito vya Malagarasi vinavyofurika vivuko na mashamba wakati wa mvua kubwa, na moto wa kiangazi kwenye misitu inayozunguka.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to know the low crossings on your route, keep stores above flood level and keep fire breaks around homes.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujua vivuko vya chini kwenye njia zenu, kuhifadhi mali juu ya kiwango cha mafuriko na kuweka njia za kuzuia moto kuzunguka nyumba.

C114.name: Kigoma District Council
C114.documented: earthquake, Lake Tanganyika waves and boat accidents, heavy rain, and shore floods

area.en: Kigoma DC: lakeshore villages and the Luiche delta
area.sw: Kigoma DC: vijiji vya ufukweni na delta ya Luiche

risk.en: This area includes lakeshore fishing villages and the Luiche river delta, which floods in heavy rain; lake storms capsize boats and cholera spreads where water is unsafe.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linajumuisha vijiji vya wavuvi vya ufukweni na delta ya mto Luiche inayofurika wakati wa mvua kubwa; dhoruba za ziwani hupindua vyombo na kipindupindu husambaa pasipo maji salama.

advice.en: For those fishing and living here, it helps to wear life jackets, keep homes off the delta flood plain, and use latrines and safe drinking water.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaovua na kuishi hapa, ni vyema kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa, kujenga nje ya tambarare ya mafuriko ya delta, na kutumia vyoo na maji salama ya kunywa.

C116.name: Uvinza District Council
C116.documented: earthquake, Malagarasi floods, lake waves at the river mouth, and heavy rain

area.en: Uvinza: Malagarasi wetlands and remote lakeshore
area.sw: Uvinza: ardhioevu ya Malagarasi na ufukwe wa mbali

risk.en: This area includes the Malagarasi wetlands and a long, remote Lake Tanganyika shore where floods isolate villages, lake storms are sudden and help can take many hours to arrive.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linajumuisha ardhioevu ya Malagarasi na ufukwe mrefu wa mbali wa Ziwa Tanganyika ambapo mafuriko hutenga vijiji, dhoruba za ziwani huja ghafla na msaada unaweza kuchukua saa nyingi kufika.

advice.en: For those living, fishing and farming here, it helps to keep homes above the wetland margin, travel by water only in calm weather and keep food, water and medicine reserves.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi, kuvua na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujenga juu ya kingo za ardhioevu, kusafiri majini wakati wa hali tulivu tu na kuweka akiba ya chakula, maji na dawa.
